messages.subject: Round 1017 report complete
messages.body: I compared device AOT, process-local reuse, and persistent SYCL cache for the pinned Arc B570 stack and wrote the bounded decision-support report. The current receipts do not attribute unclassified CPU to JIT; they instead support trace-confirmed host attribution and separately labeled first-long, later-same-process, and fresh-process cache-hit probes. AOT remains conditional on exact v711/BMG toolchain support, and Main must run the two proposed probes after the active mode10 run closes.
